_comment: Short links: housetandem.com/<slug> redirects to <to> with these UTM tags. Edit, then run: node tools/build-links.js

playtest.title: House Tandem Discord
playtest._note: Steam Playtest announcement (2026-11-07). Its own invite so Discord > Server Settings > Invites counts Steam joins. The invite expires after 30 days: then point this at the /discord invite and rebuild.

discord.title: House Tandem Discord
discord._note: Share housetandem.com/discord everywhere. If an invite leaks to bots, make a new never-expiring invite, change it here, rebuild.
